title: Soccer superstar Kylian Mbappé on ending 20-year journey with Nike: 'It was time to change'
summary_full: Soccer Champion Kylian Mbappé said he was ready for "change" after ending his association with Nike and entering a deal with Swiss sportswear brand On.
